title: Report fuel prices to the price reporting system
what: As the responsible fuel retailer at a service station, enter each fuel's normal price and other details into the aggregation system within the time required, and report temporary unavailability within 30 minutes.

sources.title: Fair Trading (Fuel Price Reporting) Regulation 2018 (Qld)
sources.quote: The responsible fuel retailer must ensure the following information is entered into the aggregation system within the period mentioned in subsection (2)— (a) the normal fuel price for the type of fuel

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Fair Trading Act 1989 (Qld)
